1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline solutions__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not comprise sodium hydroxide or other alkaline solutions__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from the group consisting of cellulase, hemicellulase, and pectinase, but not including gentle sonication__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by a method comprising cold and heat treatment followed by agitation, or heating and agitation, performed in the absence of enzymatic cell wall degradation__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and performing the cold and heat treatment or heating steps prior to addition of said magnetic particles__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __and the method does not comprise gentle sonication__.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed without prior gentle sonication of the shed cellular material__.

14. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotyping is performed to correlate phenotypic traits with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __without prior gentle sonication of the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection is based on genotypic markers not disclosed in Bullock__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __wherein the germination occurs after the genotypic selection and the embryos retain viability following the molecular analysis__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and wherein the automation does not include the collection of shed cellular material by agitation in alkaline solution__.
